svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Print a strip 200 long: a top 30 deep x 12 tall and, under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its front edge, a lip 6 deep x 6 tall (front face 18 tall).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 5.2 mm hole through it front to back, 20 from the right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end and 9 up from the bottom of the lip, for the light.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push the 5 mm panel light in from the front: its 8 mm bezel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sits on the front face. Stick the 120 x 10 name plate on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front face, 10 from the left end, level with the light.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: glue the top to the front of the jacket's top panel with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: foam-safe adhesive, centred on the door, the lip resting on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front frame's top edge and its front flush with the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lead: out of the back, straight back along the top panel, right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: along its back edge to 23 from the right end, down the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: panel to the controller's top; clips every 100 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the light shows when the controller switches it on.
